prompt: Still no sound when I try to watch it
response:
That's the only movie and it has 5.1 (6-channel) audio. **This is the real cause** — Firefox and some mobile browsers don't support 5.1 AAC in MP4 and silently produce no audio.

The fix is to re-encode the audio track to stereo (2ch) while keeping the video untouched:

```bash
ffmpeg -i "Peaky.Blinders.The.Immortal.Man.2026.1080p.mp4" \
  -c:v copy -c:a aac -ac 2 \
  "Peaky.Blinders.The.Immortal.Man.2026.1080p.stereo.mp4"
```

This will take a few minutes. Once done, you'd replace the original file with the new one. Want me to run it?
